Staffer.description: A librarian or assistant working at the branch. A first name alone is not an identity.

Patron.description: A card holder who borrows or reserves from the branch.

Title.description: A book or other item in the branch catalogue, by its title.

StaffLink.description: How two staffers are paired: one is the other's line manager, or a buddy who shadows them.

Hold.description: A patron's claim on a title: borrowing it now, or waiting for it as a reserver.

Event.description: A programme run in the branch. proposed_by suggested it, host runs it, cover stands in; status is proposed, confirmed, held or cancelled.

Fine.description: A charge on a patron's account. waived stays empty until a waiver is recorded.

questions.q: Who is Pavel Horvat's line manager?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Staffer)-[:line_manager]->(n1:Staffer) WHERE n0.name = 'Pavel Horvat' RETURN n1.name AS name

questions.speaker: pavel_n
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Staffer)-[:buddy]->(n1:Staffer) WHERE id(n0) = $speaker RETURN n1.name AS name

questions.speaker: ngozi
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Staffer)-[:reports]->(n1:Staffer) WHERE id(n0) = $speaker RETURN n1.name AS name

questions.q: Who are the borrowers of The Salt Road?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Title)-[:borrowers]->(n1:Patron) WHERE n0.heading = 'The Salt Road' RETURN n1.borrower AS borrower

questions.q: Which titles am I the borrower of?
questions.speaker: kenji
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Patron)-[:borrower]->(n1:Title) WHERE id(n0) = $speaker RETURN n1.heading AS heading

questions.q: Who is on the waitlist for A History of Lighthouses?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Title)-[:waitlist]->(n1:Patron) WHERE n0.heading = 'A History of Lighthouses' RETURN n1.borrower AS borrower

questions.q: How many seats did the author talk have?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Event) WHERE n0.program = 'author talk' RETURN n0.seats AS seats

questions.q: Which events did Tariq Haddad propose?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Staffer)<-[:proposed_by]-(n1:Event) WHERE n0.name = 'Tariq Haddad' RETURN n1.program AS program

questions.speaker: ingrid
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Staffer)<-[:host]-(n1:Event) WHERE id(n0) = $speaker RETURN n1.program AS program

questions.q: Is there a record of the poetry evening being ticketed?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Event) WHERE n0.program = 'poetry evening' RETURN coalesce(n0.ticketed, false) AS ticketed
MATCH (n0:Event) WHERE n0.program = 'coding club' RETURN n0.ticketed AS ticketed

questions.q: Has Siddharth Rao's fine been waived?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Patron)<-[:patron]-(n1:Fine) WHERE n0.borrower = 'Siddharth Rao' RETURN n1.waived AS waived

questions.q: What reason and amount does each fine have?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Fine) RETURN n0.reason AS reason, n0.amount_pence AS amount_pence

questions.q: Which desk is Ngozi Eze on?

questions.q: Which room is the story hour in?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Event) WHERE n0.program = 'story hour' RETURN n0.room AS room
